verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships an official `local-ai` binary with documented subcommands: `models list`, `run` for gallery, HuggingFace and Ollama models, and `chat`, an agent in your shell that runs commands behind an approval gate. It also takes CLI flags such as `--external-grpc-backends`, so the CLI directly serves AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: a comprehensive CLI command reference in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: local-ai models list          # List available models in the gallery
local-ai chat reads your files and runs commands on your machine, behind an approval gate you control.
The --external-grpc-backends parameter in the CLI can be used either to specify a local backend (a file) or a remote URL.
